master.prompt:

Two broad ivory hooves softly embrace its sides. Pony head emerges above the clipboard, ears both visible. Board and pony form one compact coherent silhouette, no floating separate prop. Use only ivory and cobalt-blue for character and board, solid gently muted sky-blue background #DDECF8. Broad clean color regions, around 7 dominant shapes; no delicate outlines, fur details or tiny components. Friendly rounded graphic forms, readable at 32x32. Upright, slightly toward lower-left, character and clipboard together dominate85–95% of the full square. Preserve small comfortable margins around ears and board so the whole identity is readable. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment. No photorealistic texture, glossy hotspots, strong3D, cast shadow, scene, text, watermark, card frame or presentation mask. Full-bleed square background with square outer corners.
